**Finding: Compliant (preferred position).**

No liquidated damages, penalty, or Customer-payable early-termination/minimum charge exists anywhere in the agreement:

- **§ 9.4** — Customer may terminate for convenience on 30 days' notice, owing Fees only for conforming Services rendered, with refund of prepaid Fees; Vendor gets no reciprocal convenience right.
- **§ 7.1** — Vendor may not impose platform, administration, or minimum-use charges not identified in the Order Form.
- **§ 27.3** — force-majeure termination is expressly "without penalty."
- **§ 7.3** — no interest on amounts ultimately found not due.

The only Customer-payable amounts found (§ 22.2 audit shortfall) are true-up of unpaid Fees, not liquidated damages. The § 2.1 take-or-pay commitment is a volume commitment, not an LD/penalty mechanic, and belongs to the minimum-commitment rule — noted in the rationale rather than double-flagged here. No redline proposed.
